density.title: Why Nations Fail
density.basis: Publisher contents and preface; retained prior assessments; user report of a complete reading. No new full-text audit.
density.reason: Comparative cases add historical knowledge about institutional change, growth, resistance to innovation and persistence. Reusing the inclusive/extractive framework does not erase that learning. The old D6 reason did not identify dispensable passages. The contents distinguish critical junctures, growth under extraction, institutional drift and feedback; these are additional explanatory tasks. Some thesis restatement remains, so the available evidence supports high learning yield rather than a claim that every paragraph is indispensable.

density.title: The Righteous Mind
density.basis: Author introduction and full author-posted chapter 7 sample; prior assessments. The user comparison is a report, not a measured density ratio.
density.reason: The sampled chapter adds distinctions about innate versus fixed traits, moral triggers, reciprocity, group loyalty and authority versus coercion, with experiments and concrete cases. The three-part structure extends from intuition to moral diversity and group cooperation. These examples teach different content even when they reuse a framework. The old D7 reason confused that reuse with repetition. Narrative setup and recaps remain; the sample does not establish uniformly exceptional density across the whole book.

density.title: A Thousand Brains
density.basis: Publisher description, author/company outline and independent detailed review by Calum Chace; retained assessment. No complete direct-text reading in this review.
density.reason: Cortical columns, reference frames and model consensus supply a useful educational core. The prior D8 rationale judged its compactness without accounting for the whole book. A substantial later allocation moves to machine intelligence and humanity’s future, with less sustained explanatory development and more broad extrapolation. This supports a mixed learning-yield assessment. Speculation is not automatically padding, and the later sections still contain ideas; neither a near-zero rating nor a tenfold deficit is established.
